hints: Express the transition from $y = x^2$ to $y = 4(x-3)^2 - 8$ as horizontal and vertical transformations.
A vertical stretch by scale factor 4 must occur before a downward translation by 8 units.
The horizontal shift by 3 units to the right can be combined into a single translation vector with the vertical shift.
walkthrough:
Identify the vertical stretch applied to $y = x^2$:
$$\text{Stretch with scale factor } 4 \text{ in the } y\text{-direction (parallel to the } y\text{-axis), giving } y = 4x^2$$

Identify the horizontal and vertical translations needed to reach $y = 4(x-3)^2 - 8$:
$$\text{Translation of } 3 \text{ units in the positive } x\text{-direction and } 8 \text{ units in the negative } y\text{-direction}$$

State the complete sequence of transformations with correct order:
$$\text{1. Stretch with scale factor } 4 \text{ in the } y\text{-direction (parallel to the } y\text{-axis)}$$
$$\text{2. Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ -8 \end{pmatrix}$$
